hooks.command: if [ -n "${MANIFOLD_PANE_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "${MANIFOLDD_DBUS_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then busctl --quiet --address="$MANIFOLDD_DBUS_ADDRESS" call "${MANIFOLDD_DBUS_DESTINATION:-org.manifold.Session}" /org/manifold/Agent org.manifold.Agent RegisterAgent "sa{ss}" codex 5 pane_id "$MANIFOLD_PANE_ID" status running cwd "${PWD:-}" source codex-hook surface_session "${MANIFOLD_SURFACE_SESSION_ID:-1}" >/dev/null || true; fi
